notes.title: Poké Mart
notes.text: Buy and sell items in the Pokémon window. Cities and towns have a Mart; the story can open specialty shops. Prices come from the item catalogue, stock grows with badges, shops buy at half price, and every 10 Poké Balls bring a Premier Ball. Items go straight into the Pokémon bag and the price comes out of your RoleForge wallet in the same save.

notes.title: Trainer prize money
notes.text: Beating a trainer pays the highest opponent level × 40 (Gym Leader 100, Elite Four and Champion 200). Story Gym Leaders now award badges. Paying half when you lose is optional and off by default.

notes.title: Shop settings
notes.text: Settings > Shop & prize money turns the shop, prize money, the defeat penalty, the Premier Ball bonus and selling on or off, sets prices from ×0.5 to ×2 and offers a Sandbox shop that works anywhere.
